rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using name + ZIP, accessed only the authenticated user’s orders, found the earbuds in the pending order #W5061109, presented valid blue variants, summarized the exact change and price difference, obtained explicit confirmation, and successfully executed the modification with the correct new item and refund amount. However, the agent stated “No further modifications or cancellations can be made to this order” without any support from tools or stated policy. This is an unsupported claim and falls under the fail condition of stating information not backed by tools or policy. A minor additional concern is the assumption that the refund would go to the “original payment method (PayPal)” without visible confirmation of the original payment method in the order’s payment history, though the tool call did route the difference to PayPal. Overall, due to the unsupported restriction communicated to the user, the interaction does not fully meet the pass bar.
